data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 海风里的尾巴防线
data.description: 【海港白沙滩·盛夏午后】旅途抵达海边后，她换上红棕色系的端庄泳装，坐在木质海滩椅上给尾巴擦干；浪花扑到靴边，她抬手挡住阳光，耳朵和尾巴同时因为海风欢快地动起来。
data.action: 海滩椅上整理尾巴并抬手遮阳，海浪溅到鞋边时耳尾一起欢快晃动
data.lighting: clear summer sun with sea-sparkle reflections
data.promptProse: Raphtalia from The Rising of the Shield Hero wears a modest red-brown one-piece swimsuit with a cream beach shirt, woven belt and light sandals. She sits sideways on a weathered beach chair, carefully drying the striped tail she kept clear of the tide. She raises one hand against the sun and laughs when a bright wave reaches her sandals, her raccoon ears and pink eyes sharing the same unguarded holiday delight. clear summer sun with sea-sparkle reflections.
